Convert BirdFlowRoutes to an sf object

Source: R/sf_methods.R
st_as_sf.BirdFlowRoutes.Rd

st_as_sf() method for BirdFlowRoutes objects. Converts the routes to either line geometries (one line per route, type = "line") or point geometries (one point per route location, type = "point").

Usage

# S3 method for class 'BirdFlowRoutes'
st_as_sf(x, type = "line", crs = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A BirdFlowRoutes object.

type

Either "line" (the default), to return one line per route, or "point", to return one point per row of route data.

crs

The coordinate reference system to assign to the result. If NULL (the default) the CRS is taken from x$geom$crs (or x$crs, if x has no geom component).

...

Not used.

Value

An sf object: LINESTRING geometries (one row per route) if type = "line", or POINT geometries (one row per route location) if type = "point".

Examples

# \donttest{
bf <- BirdFlowExamples::amewoo
rts <- route(bf, n = 3)
sf::st_as_sf(rts, type = "line")
#> Set crs based on geom component.
#> Simple feature collection with 3 features and 1 field
#> Geometry type: LINESTRING
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 5475000 ymin: 9675000 xmax: 7575000 ymax: 11925000
#> Projected CRS: Custom_Lambert_Azimuthal
#>   route_id                       geometry
#> 1        1 LINESTRING (6375000 9975000...
#> 2        2 LINESTRING (6975000 1027500...
#> 3        3 LINESTRING (5625000 9675000...
sf::st_as_sf(rts, type = "point")
